facts.fact: The Uganda Registration Services Bureau says its eRegistry online platform, which replaced the Online Business Registration System, is running, and its new URSB Connect app adds company and business-name registration as an extra channel.

URSB launched the URSB Connect mobile app, which it says gives access to company and business-name registration, name searches, annual returns, trademark services and the SIMPO chattels registry without visiting its offices.

UGA.note: The document concerns business and IP registration, not civil registration of births or deaths.
